001: I'm starting my part-time job at the convenience store today.
Oh, really? How was your first day?
Learning how to use the register was tough.
But I'm sure you'll get the hang of it soon.
If there's anything you don't understand, just ask me.
002: My new part-time job has a high hourly wage.
It's twelve hundred yen an hour.
That's great. Why is it so high?
It seems they want someone who can work on weekends too.
I see, that makes sense then.
003: Could you cover my shift today?
Why so sudden? Did something happen?
A university class got scheduled at the last minute.
That's rough. What time is your shift?
From five to nine in the evening.
Okay, I'll cover it for you.
004: I got scolded by a customer at work.
That must have been tough. But it happens to everyone.
Hearing you say that makes me feel a bit better.
Just be careful next time and you'll be fine.
005: How much was your paycheck this month?
It went up a little from last month.
Well, you picked up a lot of shifts.
Yeah, it was worth all the hard work.
Are you going to buy something?
I'm thinking about buying a new computer.
006: The manager at my part-time job is really strict.
I often get told that my greetings are too quiet.
That's tough. But it's important once you start working full-time.
Maybe, but it gets me down a little.
I'm rooting for you, so do your best.
007: I had an interview for a part-time job at a cafe.
How did it go? Did it feel promising?
Yeah, it felt pretty good, I guess.
That's great. When will you hear back?
They said they'd contact me in three days.
Exciting. I hope you get it.
008: A new person joined my part-time job.
Oh, really? What are they like?
They go to the same university, and they seem easy to talk to.
That's nice. Do you think you'll get along?
Yeah, we actually made plans to get lunch together sometime.
Nice. Work should be more fun now.
009: I'm thinking about quitting my part-time job.
It's hard to balance it with my studies.
That is tough, I'll admit. But it'd be a waste to quit.
You think so? I'll think about it a little more.
010: I got my shifts for this month just as I requested.
That's great. How many days are you working?
Three days a week, twelve days in total.
That's quite a lot. Are you okay?
Yeah, I adjusted it so it doesn't overlap with my classes.
That's a relief then. Good luck!
